definitions.explanation: An animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal.
A person or thing that falls victim to something harmful or exploitative. Often used figuratively for someone taken advantage of.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さな{魚|さかな}は{大|おお}きな{魚|さかな}の{餌食|えじき}になる。
examples.english: Small fish become prey for larger fish.

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}の{餌食|えじき}にならないように{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful not to fall prey to scammers.

examples.japanese: {不景気|ふけいき}で{多|おお}くの{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}が{倒産|とうさん}の{餌食|えじき}になった。
examples.english: Many small and medium businesses fell victim to bankruptcy due to the recession.

notes:
## Key Pattern
- ～の{餌食|えじき}になる — to become prey to; to fall victim to

## Usage
The figurative sense (2) is more common in everyday language. It carries a strong negative connotation of being helplessly consumed or exploited.

## Related Words
- {獲物|えもの} — prey; game (what a hunter catches)
- {犠牲|ぎせい} — sacrifice; victim (more formal)
